instances.claim: This tells me that the work is an open-ended process of continual redefinition — and then tells me again, and then once more.
instances.why: Line 16 has already delivered 'continually redefined' as the endpoint of the five-transformation sequence; 17 ('indeterminate and continually redefined'), 18 ('an ongoing process of redefinition') and 20 ('unfolds continually') each assert that same point without moving register — 17 and 18 add no mechanism, no object, no audience and no change of form, and 20 already contains both of them while also doing the form work ('is a becoming') and the audience work ('actions of its participants'). Keep 20; the shared root 'redefin-' across 16, 17 and 18 marks the padding.
